sections.text:
Equipment:
 Vertical Regenerative Air 
 Heater
 Ljungstrom

This document lists the 
equipment inspection I1, of 
vertical rotary regenerative air heater, which must be, performed every month 
and six months as indicated by M1, M6 in the title block.

Regenerative air heater used for saving heat from flue gasses and use this heat 
for heating combustion air to increase boiler efficiency.

The first draft is 
prepared by eng. Abdalla Mohamed Abdalla. reviewed by directed by 
eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, 
accepted by general director eng. M. Abd El-salam, approved by eng: Michael Goerge: Head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW, 
and cretified by 
eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPCo. Inspection and quality control Head Sector

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Switch off the circuit breaker for the motor of 
 regenerative air heater

Disconnect the electrical cable feeding of the 
 motor regenerative air heater
The regenerative air heater must be isolated mechanically
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Suitable lifting device. Feeler gauge

Hammer,
 Dial indicator, and
 Suitable jacks
Check the bearing oil level and adjust as required.

Check the main bearing temperature refer to " start - stop sequence" for 
 alarm and trip temp.
Check the bearing cooling water flow.
Check the lube oil cct for oil leakage.
Check the regenerative air heater for smooth operation.
Check all bolts and support steel fasteners bolts, and tighten if necessary.
Check the bearing oil for contamination.
Check the oiller of the air heater.
Check the air filter
Check the differential pressure of the oil filter of the guide bearing

Check the cooling water temperature of the guide bearing (not increase than 
 38c)
Check the clearance regard to figure 1
Examine all heating surface for any signs of erosion
Examine air heater housing for signs of wear
Examine damper damper assemblies for wear of blades and blade spindles

Examine bearings and couplings and make adjustments or replacements if 
 necessary. Give particular attention to bearing seals and change if needed
Check all seal clearance and adjust as required. (see Figure no 1)
Check shaft seals.
Check coupling alignment.
Check the over running clutches.
Check and inspect the air motor.
